blocks.text: At 55, Gil Aducal Morales, popularly known as “Ate Gay,” had built a name in Philippine show business based on sheer grit and distinctive talent to make people laugh with his seamless mash-ups, earning a spot in the hearts of thousands of Filipinos, both here and abroad. He was 24 when he first ventured into comedy bars. Last year, he celebrated his 30th year in an entertainment industry he had repeatedly professed to love dearly.
